step1_analysis.description: A robust multi-phase level shifter using a cross-coupled PMOS latch and PMOS cascodes to translate low-voltage control signals to a high-voltage floating domain for a Class-D audio amplifier.

tdelay_set.description: Propagation delay from SET input to P_C output rising

sky130_expected.calculation: 2 gate delays (NMOS pull-down + PMOS pull-up). With W=5u, L=0.5u, Cload=10fF, delay ~ (C*V)/I ~ (10fF * 1.8V) / 1mA ~ 18ps. Adding parasitic and cascode delay, expect ~100-500ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 1.8V devices are much faster than the high-voltage BCD devices used in the original paper.

vmin_sc.description: Minimum voltage at the cascode source node (S_C)

sky130_expected.calculation: When NMOS pulls drain to 0V, PMOS cascode (gate at 0V) turns off when source drops to |Vth| + body effect. |Vth0| = 0.42V, with Vsb ~ -1V, |Vth| ~ 0.7V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Demonstrates the cascode protection mechanism limiting the voltage swing on the low-voltage NMOS drains.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the level shifter

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = f * C * V^2. f=10MHz, C~100fF, V=1.8V. P ~ 3.2uW. Plus short-circuit current during transitions.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low power consumption is expected as it only drives small internal latch nodes.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure propagation delay, cascode voltage limiting, and power consumption of the level shifter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Level Shifter
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM8 R_C P_C V_BOOT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM13 D_C R_C V_BOOT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM7 S_C D_C V_BOOT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM14 P_C S_C V_BOOT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM5 S_B V_OUT S_C VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 R_B V_OUT R_C VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM11 D_B V_OUT D_C VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 P_B V_OUT P_C VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM3 S_B SET GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 R_B RESET GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM10 P_B PRECHARGE GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM9 D_B DISCHARGE GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBOOT V_BOOT 0 1.8
VOUT V_OUT 0 0
VSET SET 0 PULSE(0 1.8 10n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 100n)
VRESET RESET 0 PULSE(0 1.8 10n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 100n)
VPRE PRECHARGE 0 PULSE(0 1.8 60n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 100n)
VDIS DISCHARGE 0 PULSE(0 1.8 60n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 100n)

C1 S_C 0 10f
C2 R_C 0 10f
C3 D_C 0 10f
C4 P_C 0 10f

.control
tran 0.1n 200n
meas tran tdelay_pre trig v(precharge) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(r_c) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran tdelay_set trig v(set) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(p_c) val=0.9 rise=2
meas tran vmin_sc min v(s_c)
meas tran vmax_sc max v(s_c)
meas tran avg_i_vboot avg i(VBOOT)
meas tran avg_i_vdd avg i(VVDD)
let power = -(avg_i_vboot + avg_i_vdd) * 1.8
print power
quit
.endc
